description.value:
"Look, I really don't care about the gold, I just wanna be the first to see what's in the chest!"

— A Young Fenari

Fluffy little nomads with the ears, tails, and legs of animals, the Fenari wander the world in caravans, chasing treasure they'd rather find than keep. When a caravan settles down, its families slowly take on the traits of the people around them, and over a few generations they become something new: a Fenari Culture.

Fenari Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid
  • Size. Small or Medium (chosen when you select this species). Some Cultures set your size.
  • Speed. 30 feet
  • Darkvision. You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet of you as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
  • Enhanced Senses. You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
  • Bite. Your fanged maw is a natural weapon you can use to make Unarmed Strikes, dealing 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage on a hit.
  • Natural Jumper. You always count as having a running start when you jump, and you take half damage from falling.
  • Culture. Choose one of the Fenari Cultures below. It grants traits at 1st, 3rd, and 5th level.

Cultures

@UUID[Compendium.sifs-fenari-5e-race.the-fenari.Item.trAPujoUoXXEJfmO]{Dragonborn Culture}Dazzling, scaled Fenari with dragon breath and burning fangs.
@UUID[Compendium.sifs-fenari-5e-race.the-fenari.Item.g4eNDQWK3GC43HOd]{Dwarven Culture}Tough, stubborn brawlers and stone-lovers who can drink anyone under the table.
@UUID[Compendium.sifs-fenari-5e-race.the-fenari.Item.rebBCx11L14bg5Dn]{Elven Culture}Patient forest hunters who are impossible to find until they pounce.
@UUID[Compendium.sifs-fenari-5e-race.the-fenari.Item.fz2dJM3OO9wAyxBO]{Fairy Culture}Tiny winged tricksters for whom the rules don't apply.
@UUID[Compendium.sifs-fenari-5e-race.the-fenari.Item.xjzbtWqXbdnadyLp]{Goliath Culture}Stocky mountain underdogs who keep score and grow to match.
@UUID[Compendium.sifs-fenari-5e-race.the-fenari.Item.xeRpPUNsWQZcHUZ0]{Human Culture}Ambitious market-town opportunists who can learn anything.
@UUID[Compendium.sifs-fenari-5e-race.the-fenari.Item.2fc0zMAXCvy6gTlS]{Halfling Culture}Lucky little gourmands who love an audience.
@UUID[Compendium.sifs-fenari-5e-race.the-fenari.Item.5R4rcsfN2Rc9yw4N]{Gnome Culture}Endlessly curious tinkerers whose experiments mostly work.
@UUID[Compendium.sifs-fenari-5e-race.the-fenari.Item.cfj2uAkVq0T7gGx7]{Kobold Culture}Tiny, loud, fiercely loyal, and much braver than they look.

See the The Fenari journal for their history, the Creed, and every Culture.
